_doc: Values of run VMA for application CARV (logs/VMA.events.txt, logs/VMA.RUN_INFO, logs/VMA.time.txt, logs/VMA.image.elf): simulation (simulate.sh) of a git archive of tag r11-rc9 (commit xxxxxxx, repo_state=archive) of carv_e (CAR-V and E on the 4x5 mesh) with the release by tick (RELEASE_MASK=1048575, release=tick), the UCX-OS kernel without nested interrupts (isr=no_nesting), the crt0.s with the return test of _isr and the read back of _interrupt_set(0) (crt0=guard_readback) and the time-triggered injection of the packets between PEs (injection=tt; table app/carv_e_tt.h with t(v) = max(CSV, static t(v) of the image), costs=max_csv_static costs_file=carv_e.json) at F_CLK = 457.6 MHz, 11.5 ms of platform time, Questa 2025.3, riscv64-elf-gcc 12.2.0, on the simulation server, 2026-10-15 (run_r11g.sh: make -C experiments/multiapp sim F_CLK=457600000 SIM_NS=11500000 BUILD=build/vma). Analysis: make -C experiments/multiapp check-vma (python -m rttools.paper.rtlapp --app CARV --composition composition.json, release rule tick from the RUN_INFO). Model of the run (the defaults of rttools): the network interface of each PE as a resource of the link schedule, o_i = L0 + 20 (m + 1) + w_NI (w_NI = 15169), and t(v) = max(CSV, static t(v)) of the costs file of RUN_INFO (experiments/wcet/costs/tt), the deadline of each packet at the release tick of its reader and the finish of each job with the handlers of the packet events of its PE (deadline=tick in RUN_INFO); tt: each packet against s_{i,j}, o_i and its deadline, each job end against F(v), each enqueue against s_{i,j}, each arrival against the start of its reader (rttools/paper/ttcheck.py).

tt.model: o_i = L0 + w_h (m + 1) + w_NI; tau = tick of the phase of the sending job
